# Lisbon Spring Trip Plan for 2 Adults

A relaxed 4-day Lisbon itinerary with museums, scenic walks, local food, and low transit stress. Budget target is **€1,200 total excluding flights**, so this plan keeps lodging comfortable but not luxury and uses a mix of walking, tram, and occasional taxi.

## 4-Day Lisbon Itinerary and Cost Plan

| Day | Focus | Highlights | Estimated Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Day 1 — Thu, Apr 16 | Historic center + riverfront | Baixa, Chiado, Carmo area, sunset at Praça do Comércio | **€230** |
| Day 2 — Fri, Apr 17 | Museum day + Belém | Museu Nacional do Azulejo or MAAT, Belém Tower area, pastel de nata stop | **€260** |
| Day 3 — Sat, Apr 18 | Scenic neighborhoods | Alfama stroll, São Jorge viewpoints, Fado dinner, slow neighborhood wandering | **€280** |
| Day 4 — Sun, Apr 19 | Easy final day | LX Factory, river walk, souvenir shopping, relaxed brunch | **€180** |

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary

### Day 1: Old Town Arrival and Easy Orientation
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and settle near Baixa, Chiado, or Avenida for easy walking.
- Afternoon: Explore Rossio, Rua Augusta, and the Carmo Convent area at a gentle pace.
- Evening: Walk to Praça do Comércio and the river for sunset; have dinner in Chiado or Bairro Alto.
- Food: Try bacalhau, grilled sardines, or a simple petiscos spread.

### Day 2: Museums and Belém by the River
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Visit the **National Tile Museum** for a calm, high-value cultural stop.
- Afternoon: Head to Belém for the Jerónimos area, riverside views, and one second museum if energy allows.
- Evening: Keep it easy with a casual dinner back in central Lisbon.
- Food: Stop for pastel de nata at a classic Belém bakery and pair it with coffee.

### Day 3: Alfama, Viewpoints, and Fado
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/music-note.svg
- Morning: Slow walk through Alfama’s narrow streets and viewpoints.
- Afternoon: Visit São Jorge Castle area only if you want more walking; otherwise stay in the lower Alfama lanes.
- Evening: Book a Fado dinner in advance for a relaxed, atmospheric night out.
- Food: Choose a traditional tavern with codfish, octopus, or pork dishes.

### Day 4: LX Factory and a Gentle Finish
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Morning: Brunch and browse LX Factory’s shops, books, and design spaces.
- Afternoon: Take a final river walk or stop at a café with a view.
- Evening: Keep dinner simple and leave room for airport transfer or a final drink.
- Food: Go for light plates, pastries, or seafood rice depending on appetite.

## Budget Breakdown for 2 Adults

| Category | Estimated Total | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Accommodation | **€520** | 3 nights in a well-located mid-range hotel or apartment |
| Food and drinks | **€320** | Breakfast, lunches, dinners, coffee, and a few treats |
| Local transport | **€60** | Metro, tram, and 1-2 taxis if needed |
| Museums and entry fees | **€120** | 2-3 paid entries plus any tower/castle admission |
| Activities and extras | **€80** | Fado, snacks, and small purchases |
| Buffer | **€100** | For overruns or a nicer dinner |
| **Total** | **€1,200** | Fits the target budget |

## Spring Packing Checklist for Lisbon

- Light jacket or trench coat
- Compact umbrella
- Comfortable walking shoes with grip
- 3-4 breathable tops
- 2-3 pairs of trousers or skirts
- One warmer layer for evenings
- Sunglasses and sunscreen
- Small day bag or crossbody bag
- Reusable water bottle
- Portable charger
- Travel adapter for Portugal/Europe
- Light scarf for breezy evenings
- Any prescription meds and basic pain relief
- Card plus a little cash for small cafés and tips

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Check museum hours] https://www.museudoazulejo.pt/
Action: [Button: Plan transit routes] https://www.metrolisboa.pt/
Action: [Button: Find Fado venues] https://www.visitlisboa.com/

## Sources

- Lisbon tourism overview: https://www.visitlisboa.com/
- Lisbon Metro: https://www.metrolisboa.pt/
- National Tile Museum: https://www.museudoazulejo.pt/
